description: Update an existing space's settings, name, or features. Requires spaceId or spaceName.

admin_can_manage.description: Whether admins can manage (Enterprise Plan only).

features.description: Feature toggles. Keys: due_dates ({enabled, start_date, remap_due_dates, remap_closed_due_date}), time_tracking, tags, time_estimates, checklists, custom_fields, remap_dependencies, dependency_warning, portfolios, sprints, points, milestones, emails, zoom. Each takes {enabled: boolean}.

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.

name: update_space
